title: IM60043: Financial Management And Accounting
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basic accounting concepts, Preparation of financial statements, Classification
of costs, Allocation, apportionment and absorption, Cost centres, Different
costing systems, Cost analysis for managerial decisions, Working capital
management, Investment analysis, Cash Flow determination, Cost of capital,
Capital budgeting methods.
Books
•Prasanna Chandra: Financial Management, (TMH), 6/e, 2004
•Brigham & Ehrhardt, Financial Management – Theory & Practice, Thomson
Learning, 10/e – 2004
